candidates.change_summary: Change supportsInterface to always return false (replace body to return false), altering observable return for many interfaceId inputs.
Change supportsInterface to always return true (replace body to return true), altering observable return for many interfaceId inputs.
Negate the original logic: return true only when interfaceId is not IERC165, flipping result for the IERC165 id and others.
Restrict to only report support for IAccessControl (drop IERC165 check), returning true only if interfaceId equals IAccessControl's id or super does (which no longer recognizes IERC165 explicitly).
Change the returned mapping lookup to check the adminRole's members instead of the role's members.
Invert the boolean result so callers get the negation of the original hasRole value.
Always return true, making hasRole report every address has every role.
Always return false, making hasRole report no address has any role.
Ignore the provided account and always check the zero address instead, returning whether the zero address has the role.
